description: This file defines a React custom hook 'useTheme' to manage and toggle themes (light/dark) across an application. It utilizes React's useState and useEffect hooks to synchronize theme state with the document's data-theme attribute.

methods.name: useTheme(defaultTheme = 'light')
methods.description: Custom React hook for managing theme state, initializing with a default theme, updating document attribute on theme change, and providing a toggle function.
